mapper.select: SELECT ST_Value(rast, ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(CAST(#{lon} AS double precision),CAST(#{lat} AS double precision)), 4326),3857)) FROM t_dem WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(CAST(#{lon} AS double precision),CAST(#{lat} AS double precision)), 4326),3857))

SELECT ST_Value(dm.rast, ps.geom) altitudesHeight, regexp_replace(st_astext(ST_Transform(ps.geom,4326),7), '^[A-Za-z]*', '') lonLat FROM t_dem AS dm, ( SELECT (st_dumppoints(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(st_geomfromewkt(#{LonLat}), 4326),3857))).geom ) AS ps WHERE ST_Intersects(dm.rast, ps.geom)
select * from get_camera_coord(#{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{height}, #{locationLongitude}, #{locationLatitude}, #{pageSize}, #{radius}) where difheight < 0 limit 1

select count(1) from layer_info where layer_name in
#{tableName}

SELECT (case when dlbm = '0101' then '水田' when dlbm = '0102' then '水浇地' when dlbm = '0103' then '旱地' end ) as codeName, dlbm as codeValue, CAST(sum(${areaCode}) as DECIMAL(18,2)) as area FROM ${tableName} where dlbm in ('0101','0102','0103') GROUP BY dlbm
SELECT gddb as value, CAST(sum(${areaCode}) as DECIMAL(18,2)) as area FROM ${tableName} where gddb is not null and dlbm in ('0101','0102','0103') GROUP BY gddb

SELECT ST_Length(ST_MakeLine(ST_MakePoint(long1, lat1), ST_MakePoint(long2, lat2))) as path_length, ST_Line_Interpolate_Point(ST_MakeLine(ST_MakePoint(long1, lat1), ST_MakePoint(long2, lat2)), 0.5) as midpoint FROM ( SELECT ST_Y(ST_Line_Interpolate_Point(ST_MakeLine(ST_MakePoint(long1, lat1), ST_MakePoint(long2, lat2)), 0.5)) - ST_Y(ST_MakePoint(long1, lat1)) as slope FROM ( SELECT (long2 - long1) as long_diff, (lat2 - lat1) as lat_diff FROM your_table ) as coordinates ) as slope_coefficients

SELECT cb.dl fuelModelNumber, cb.mc_1h moistureOneHour, cb.mc_10h moistureTenHour, cb.mc_100h moistureHundredHour, cb.mc_herb moistureLiveHerbaceous, cb.mc_woody moistureLiveWoody, cb.crownratio crownRatio, cb.canheight canopyHeight, cb.cancover canopyCover, cb.cd plantsDensity, cb.tvdi plantsDegreeOfDrought FROM global_caodi cb WHERE ST_Contains(cb.geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(CAST(#{lon} AS double precision),CAST(#{lat} AS double precision)),4326))

SELECT cb.dl fuelModelNumber, cb.cd plantsDensity, cb.tvdi plantsDegreeOfDrought FROM global_caodi cb, (SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(CAST(#{lon} AS double precision),CAST(#{lat} AS double precision)), 4326)::geography, ${distance})::geometry) t2 WHERE st_intersects ( t2.ST_Buffer, cb.geom )
SELECT cb.firelevel FROM firelevel_now cb WHERE ST_Contains(cb.geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(CAST(#{lon} AS double precision),CAST(#{lat} AS double precision)),4326))
SELECT cb.dl FROM global_lindi cb WHERE ST_Contains(cb.geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(CAST(#{lon} AS double precision),CAST(#{lat} AS double precision)),4326))

SELECT ST_Value(rast, ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(CAST(#{lon} AS double precision),CAST(#{lat} AS double precision)), 4326),3857)) FROM ${tableName} WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(CAST(#{lon} AS double precision),CAST(#{lat} AS double precision)), 4326),3857))

SELECT ST_Value(rast, ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(CAST(#{lon} AS double precision),CAST(#{lat} AS double precision)), 4326),3857)) FROM ${tableName} WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(CAST(#{lon} AS double precision),CAST(#{lat} AS double precision)), 4326),3857))

SELECT (STATS).* FROM ( SELECT ST_SUMMARYSTATS ( ST_CLIP ( ST_UNION (RAST), ST_TRANSFORM ( ST_GEOMFROMTEXT ( #{wkt}, 4326 ), 3857 ) ), 1, TRUE ) AS STATS FROM T_DEM WHERE ST_INTERSECTS ( RAST, ST_TRANSFORM ( ST_GEOMFROMTEXT ( #{wkt}, 4326 ), 3857 ) ) ) AS FOO;

SELECT samplelength,ST_NearestValue(rast,t3.samplepoint) as nearestValue FROM ( SELECT ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT (LINE, N::FLOAT8 / ${sampleNum}) AS SAMPLEPOINT,st_length(LINE)*N::FLOAT8 / ${sampleNum} as samplelength FROM ( SELECT ST_TRANSFORM ( ST_GEOMFROMTEXT ( #{wkt}, 4326 ), 3857 ) AS LINE, GENERATE_SERIES(0, ${sampleNum}) AS N ) AS T1 ) as t3 inner JOIN T_DEM T2 ON ST_INTERSECTS (st_Envelope(T2.RAST), T3.SAMPLEPOINT);

SELECT keylength, ST_NearestValue(rast,t3.keypoint) nearestValue FROM ( select (SAMPLEPOINT).geom as keypoint,ST_LineLocatePoint(line,(SAMPLEPOINT).geom)*st_length(line) as keylength from (SELECT ST_DumpPoints(line) AS SAMPLEPOINT,line FROM ( SELECT ST_TRANSFORM ( ST_GEOMFROMTEXT ( #{wkt}, 4326 ), 3857 ) AS LINE ) AS T1) as t4 ) as t3 LEFT JOIN T_DEM T2 ON ST_INTERSECTS (st_Envelope(T2.RAST), T3.keypoint);

SELECT sum(LINELENGTH / COS(MEANSLOP * (PI() / 180))) FROM ( SELECT ST_LENGTH ( ST_INTERSECTION (ST_ENVELOPE (tslope.RAST), TLINE.LINE) ) AS LINELENGTH, (ST_SummaryStats(tslope.RAST)).mean as MEANSLOP FROM ( SELECT ST_TRANSFORM ( ST_GEOMFROMTEXT ( #{wkt}, 4326 ), 3857 ) AS LINE ) AS TLINE inner JOIN t_slope tslope ON ST_INTERSECTS (ST_ENVELOPE (tslope.RAST), TLINE.LINE) ) AS FOO

SELECT sum(samplelength/cos(ST_NearestValue(rast,t3.samplepoint)* (PI() / 180))) FROM ( SELECT ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT (LINE, N::FLOAT8 / ${sampleNum}) AS SAMPLEPOINT,st_length(LINE)::FLOAT8 / ${sampleNum} as samplelength FROM ( SELECT ST_TRANSFORM ( ST_GEOMFROMTEXT ( #{wkt}, 4326 ), 3857 ) AS LINE, GENERATE_SERIES(0, ${sampleNum}) AS N ) AS T1 ) as t3 inner JOIN t_slope T2 ON ST_INTERSECTS (st_Envelope(T2.RAST), T3.SAMPLEPOINT);

SELECT sum(polygonarea / COS(MEANSLOP * (PI() / 180))) FROM ( SELECT ST_area (ST_TRANSFORM ( ST_INTERSECTION (ST_ENVELOPE (tslope.RAST), Tpolygon.polygon) ,4527)) AS polygonarea, (ST_SummaryStats(tslope.RAST)).mean as MEANSLOP FROM ( SELECT ST_TRANSFORM ( ST_GEOMFROMTEXT ( #{wkt}, 4326 ), 3857 ) AS polygon ) AS Tpolygon inner JOIN t_slope tslope ON ST_INTERSECTS (ST_ENVELOPE (tslope.RAST), Tpolygon.polygon) ) AS FOO

SELECT sum(polygonarea / COS(MEANSLOP * (PI() / 180))) FROM ( SELECT ST_area (ST_TRANSFORM ( ST_INTERSECTION (ST_ENVELOPE (tslope.RAST), Tpolygon.polygon) ,4527)) AS polygonarea, (ST_SummaryStats(ST_Clip(tslope.RAST,Tpolygon.polygon))).mean as MEANSLOP FROM ( SELECT ST_TRANSFORM ( ST_GEOMFROMTEXT ( #{wkt}, 4326 ), 3857 ) AS polygon ) AS Tpolygon inner JOIN t_slope tslope ON ST_INTERSECTS (ST_ENVELOPE (tslope.RAST), Tpolygon.polygon) ) AS FOO
